mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 2.0% in the current environment) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 1,400 thousand units), consumer confidence and spending rise, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above 105.0) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS below 500,000 million dollars) signals weak demand that reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0) and a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE above 4.0%) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO falls and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
